'I WILL MOVE TO REDUCE THE DPWH AND MMDA APPROPRIATIONS'

Following Ramon Ang's offer to voluntarily help resolve Metro Manila's flooding problem for free, Sen. Panfilo "Ping" Lacson said that he will propose budget cuts to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and the Metro Manila Development Authority's (MMDA) flood management program in the 2026 budget if San Miguel Corp. is given authorization by the government.
